every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 keeps its UI card continuously visible across transitions in frames 4 and 7, whereas Site 1 drops the text entirely and leaves the left side empty.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the identical 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9 to clearly illustrate log compression, local storage, anchored ranges, and multi-harness gates.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the exact same well-crafted, grounded 3D machinery, materials, and lighting throughout frames 1 to 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography is identical, Site 1 hides the left text panel during close-up transitions in frame 7 so it does not collide with the 3D model as it does in Site 2's frame 7.

overall.reason: Although both versions share the same 3D scene and typography, Site 1 manages scroll transitions more cleanly by hiding text panels during close-up camera moves rather than letting UI cards overlap the 3D machinery or mismatch the active scene.
